title: The canonical pair (M_V, Θ) is admissible and has weight μ_V⌞U (Simon 3.12)
statement: Assume ApproxTangentAE. Let n ≥ 1, ℓ ≥ 0, V a rectifiable n-varifold in ℝ^{n+ℓ} whose weight μ_V = V.weight is finite on compact sets, and U ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} open. Suppose that for every ξ ∈ U the quotients μ_V.real(B_ρ(ξ)) / (ω_n ρⁿ) converge as ρ ↓ 0 to Θ(ξ) := V.density ξ, i.e. V.HasDensityAt ξ (V.density ξ). Let M_V := V.canonicalCarrier U = {x ∈ U : Θ(x) > 0}. Then (M_V, Θ) is an admissible pair, i.e. IsRectifiablePair n M_V Θ: M_V is countably n-rectifiable and Hⁿ-null-measurable, Θ > 0 on M_V, and Θ is Hⁿ-integrable on M_V ∩ K for every compact K. Moreover pairWeight n M_V Θ = (Hⁿ⌞M_V).withDensity(ofReal ∘ Θ) equals μ_V⌞U.
lean_statement: ApproxTangentAE → ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ) (U : Set (Ambient n ℓ)), 0 < n → IsOpen U → IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts V.weight → (∀ ξ ∈ U, V.HasDensityAt ξ (V.density ξ)) → IsRectifiablePair n (V.canonicalCarrier U) V.density ∧ pairWeight n (V.canonicalCarrier U) V.density = V.weight.restrict U
